svg.title: The maps and states are now degree-three matrix polynomials in ε, with Gaussian rational coefficients. Here are explicit coefficients, making the positivity certificate reconstructible without fitting numerical samples. Superscript ∨denotes the Hilbert–Schmidt dual basis (F ∨= F/2, except C∨ 22 = C22/6). Define Ag,∨ j = X μ gμxjμA∨ μ, Cg,∨ j,ν = X μ gμxjμC∨ μν.
